dialogue.content: (本日は、お時間頂きありがとうございます。時間になりましたら、始めさせて頂きます。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time today. We'll begin at the scheduled time.)

dialogue.content: (宜しくお願い致します)
dialogue.English: (Thank you.)

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。はじめに、年齢・性別・相談内容をお伝え頂けますか。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm a counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 12歳、男、いじめられてます。
dialogue.English: I'm 12, a boy, and I'm being bullied.

dialogue.content: 教えてくれてありがとうございます。話せるところからで大丈夫です。どんなことが起こっていますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. It's okay to start wherever you feel comfortable. What kinds of things have been happening?

dialogue.content: 悪口や無視される。
dialogue.English: They call me names and ignore me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは辛いね。。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be really tough.

dialogue.content: うん。
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 今は何年生なのかな？
dialogue.English: What grade are you in now?

dialogue.content: 小学６年生だよ。
dialogue.English: I'm in the sixth grade.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。いつぐらいから、悪口や無視は始まったの？
dialogue.English: I see. About when did the name-calling and ignoring start?

dialogue.content: ６年になってから。
dialogue.English: Since I started the sixth grade.

dialogue.content: そっかあ。ずっと辛い事を我慢してきたんだね。
dialogue.English: I see. You've been enduring this difficult situation for a long time.

dialogue.content: うん。そう。
dialogue.English: Yeah. That's right.

dialogue.content: 今日は勇気を持って相談に来てくれたんだね。
dialogue.English: It took a lot of courage for you to come and talk about this today.

dialogue.content: うん、そうだよ。
dialogue.English: Yeah, it did.

dialogue.content: 一緒に考えていきたいと思います。
dialogue.English: I'd like us to think this through together.

dialogue.content: うん、ありがと
dialogue.English: Okay, thanks.

dialogue.content: あなたは、いじめられた時、どのような気持ちになるか教えてもらえるかな？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me how you feel when you're being bullied?

dialogue.content: 寂しいし、悲しい。
dialogue.English: I feel lonely and sad.

dialogue.content: ええ。そのように孤独を感じてつらいね。誰か周りで助けれくれる人はいるの？
dialogue.English: Yes. It must be so hard to feel that lonely. Is there anyone around who can help you?

dialogue.content: わからないけど、お母さんには心配かけたくない。
dialogue.English: I'm not sure, but I don't want to worry my mom.

dialogue.content: うんうん。お母さんには言えてないんだね。それについては、本当はどう思っているの？
dialogue.English: Mm-hm. So you haven't been able to tell your mom. How do you really feel about that?

dialogue.content: お母さんは1人だから言いたくない。
dialogue.English: My mom is on her own, so I don't want to tell her.

dialogue.content: そうなのね。教えてくれてありがとう。お母さんを大事に思っているんだね。学校の先生には相談できそうかな？
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for sharing that. You really care about your mom, don't you? Do you think you could talk to a teacher at school?

dialogue.content: 先生は好きじゃない。
dialogue.English: I don't like my teacher.

dialogue.content: そうなのね。先生にはどんな気持ちがあるのか、良かったら教えてもらえるかな？
dialogue.English: I see. If you don't mind, could you tell me how you feel about your teacher?

dialogue.content: いじめる奴らと仲がいいから。嫌い。
dialogue.English: Because he's friendly with the guys who bully me. I hate him.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいい？
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: そうだったんだね。そんな様子だと、嫌になるのも無理もなし、相談もしたくない気持ちになるよね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what's happening. Seeing that, it's no wonder you'd dislike him and not want to talk to him about it.

dialogue.content: うん。
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 悲しい。
dialogue.English: I'm sad.

dialogue.content: うん。悲しいし、つらいね。今日は勇気を持って相談に来てくれたので、一緒にがんがえましょう。
dialogue.English: Yes. It's sad and painful. You showed great courage by coming to talk today, so let's think about this together.

dialogue.content: うん。ありがと
dialogue.English: Okay. Thanks.

dialogue.content: いじめが始まったころに、何かがあったりしたのかな？
dialogue.English: Around the time the bullying started, did anything happen?

dialogue.content: クラスが変わってから。
dialogue.English: After we changed classes.

dialogue.content: なるほど。いじめてくる子たちとは、それまでどんな関係だったの？
dialogue.English: I see. What was your relationship like with the kids who bully you before that?

dialogue.content: 最初は仲良くしてたけど。わからない。
dialogue.English: At first we got along, but... I don't know.

dialogue.content: そっかあ。特に何があったわけでもないから、よけいに寂しくなるし、くやしいね。
dialogue.English: I see. Since nothing specific happened, it must make you feel even more lonely and frustrated.

dialogue.content: うん。悔しいよー！
dialogue.English: Yeah. It’s so frustrating!

dialogue.content: そうだよね。心が痛くなるのを感じるよ。
dialogue.English: I can imagine. I can feel how much your heart must ache.

dialogue.content: お昼休みや休憩時間は、どのように過ごしてるの？
dialogue.English: How do you spend your time during lunch and recess?

dialogue.content: 1人だよ。
dialogue.English: I'm alone.

dialogue.content: 絵を描いてる。
dialogue.English: I draw pictures.

dialogue.content: そっかぁ。絵を描いているとどんな気持ちなるの？
dialogue.English: I see. How do you feel when you're drawing?

dialogue.content: 悲しくなるよ。
dialogue.English: I feel sad.

dialogue.content: お父さんの絵を描くよ。
dialogue.English: I draw pictures of my dad.

dialogue.content: どうしてお父さんの絵をかくのか、良かったら教えてもらえるかな？
dialogue.English: If you're okay with it, could you tell me why you draw pictures of your dad?

dialogue.content: お父さん。天国にいたから。
dialogue.English: My dad... because he's in heaven.

dialogue.content: そうだったんだね。教えてくれてありがとう。お父さんの絵をかきながら、お父さんを思い出すと寂しくなるんだね。
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for telling me. Drawing pictures of your dad and remembering him makes you feel lonely, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: うん。悲しい！
dialogue.English: Yeah. It makes me sad!

dialogue.content: 良い人は早く亡くなるの？
dialogue.English: Do good people die early?

dialogue.content: お父さんは良い人だったんだね。
dialogue.English: Your dad was a good person, wasn't he?

dialogue.content: 優しかった！
dialogue.English: He was kind!

dialogue.content: いつも遊んでくれたし。
dialogue.English: And he always played with me.

dialogue.content: うん。うん。そうなんだ。素敵なお父さんだったんだね。
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm. I see. He sounds like a wonderful father.

dialogue.content: うん。ヒーロー！
dialogue.English: Yeah. A hero!

dialogue.content: すごいね。
dialogue.English: That's amazing.

dialogue.content: 凄いよ！
dialogue.English: He really was!

dialogue.content: いてくれたら。助けてくれたのに。
dialogue.English: If he were here... he would have helped me.

dialogue.content: うん。そうだね。お父さん、かっこいいね。あなたは、お父さんのようにヒーローになりたいと思うのかな？
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm sure he would have. Your dad sounds so cool. Do you think you want to be a hero like your dad?

dialogue.content: 僕は人に優しくしたい。
dialogue.English: I want to be kind to people.

dialogue.content: 大人になってもイジメはあるの？
dialogue.English: Does bullying still happen when you're an adult?

dialogue.content: うん。それも素敵だね。ヒーローは、優しいことも大事だと思うけどどうかな？
dialogue.English: Mmm. That's a wonderful thing to want. I think being kind is an important part of being a hero, what do you think?

dialogue.content: 大人もあるよ
dialogue.English: Yes, it happens to adults too.

dialogue.content: そうか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 強くならないといけないのかな。
dialogue.English: Do I have to become strong?

dialogue.content: あなたにとって、優しいってどんなことか、教えてもらえるかな？強いことと近いのかな？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me what being "kind" means to you? Do you think it's similar to being "strong"?

dialogue.content: イジメられてる子がいたら。助けたい。
dialogue.English: If I saw someone being bullied... I'd want to help them.

dialogue.content: 同じ思い、わかるから。
dialogue.English: Because I know how it feels.

dialogue.content: うん。うん。そうだね。気持ちがわかる事はとっても大事だと思う。
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm. That's right. I think understanding how they feel is very important.

dialogue.content: うん。ありがと
dialogue.English: Yeah. Thanks.

dialogue.content: 優しいね。
dialogue.English: You're kind.

dialogue.content: ありがとう。あなたは、今、すでに優しい気持ちをもっていると感じるよ。もし誰かがいじめられていたら、何て言ってあげたい？
dialogue.English: Thank you. I feel that you already have a very kind heart. If someone was being bullied, what would you want to say to them?

dialogue.content: 僕が守るよって。
dialogue.English: I'd say, 'I'll protect you.'

dialogue.content: 弱いからイジメられる。
dialogue.English: People get bullied because they're weak.

dialogue.content: すばらしいよ。そして強いを思うんだけど、あなたはどう思うかな。
dialogue.English: That's wonderful. It also sounds strong to me—what do you think?

dialogue.content: 今は弱いと感じているのかな？
dialogue.English: Do you feel weak right now?

dialogue.content: イジメられてる。から。
dialogue.English: Because... I'm being bullied.

dialogue.content: イジメている人の事は強いと感じる？
dialogue.English: Do you think the people bullying you are strong?

dialogue.content: 人とは思ってない。
dialogue.English: I don't think of them as people.

dialogue.content: そうなのね。どのように思っているの？
dialogue.English: I see. How do you think of them?

dialogue.content: 人間のくず。
dialogue.English: Human scum.

dialogue.content: そのように思っているのね。
dialogue.English: That's how you feel about them.

dialogue.content: うん。
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: だから。強くなればたおせるかな？
dialogue.English: So... if I become strong, can I defeat them?

dialogue.content: そうかもしれないね。あなたは、どう思う？
dialogue.English: Maybe so. What do you think?

dialogue.content: お父さんなら。倒せるよって言うと思う。
dialogue.English: If it were my dad, I think he'd say, "You can defeat them."

dialogue.content: うん。うん。あなたはお父さんの子だから強くなれると思うよ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm. You're your father's son, so I think you can become strong.

dialogue.content: うん。そうだよね！
dialogue.English: Yeah, that's right!

dialogue.content: うん。うん。私は今日話していて、あなたはヒーローになれると思う。あなたは、倒したいって思う？
dialogue.English: Mm-hm. From talking with you today, I think you can become a hero. Do you feel you want to defeat them?

dialogue.content: うん。ぶっとばしたい！
dialogue.English: Yeah. I want to send them flying!

dialogue.content: そっかぁ！
dialogue.English: I see!

dialogue.content: うん！
dialogue.English: Yeah!

dialogue.content: がんばる。
dialogue.English: I'll do my best.

dialogue.content: ぶっとばしたいという気持ちも自然だと思うよ
dialogue.English: I think it's natural to feel like you want to send them flying.

dialogue.content: うん。
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 優しくて、強い倒し方ってどんなのがあると思う？
dialogue.English: What do you think would be a kind and strong way to defeat them?

dialogue.content: かたとおとし
dialogue.English: Shoulder throw.

dialogue.content: 笑
dialogue.English: (laughs)

dialogue.content: わからない
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: かたとおとし？（笑）
dialogue.English: Shoulder throw? (laughs)

dialogue.content: 凄い楽しく話せたから。大丈夫！
dialogue.English: I had a really fun time talking, so I'm okay!

dialogue.content: 先生を超えて、校長先生とかにいうのは、どうかな？
dialogue.English: What about going over the teacher's head and telling someone like the principal?

dialogue.content: ありがとう
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫。僕が自分で倒す。倒せなかったら。またきていい？
dialogue.English: It's okay. I'll defeat them myself. If I can't, can I come back?

dialogue.content: うん。もちろん。いつでも相談に来てください。あなたは、勇気があってとっても格好いいよ。
dialogue.English: Yes, of course. Please come back anytime. You're brave and very cool.

dialogue.content: うん。ありがと
dialogue.English: Okay. Thanks.

dialogue.content: またくるかも
dialogue.English: I might come back.

dialogue.content: 負けたら
dialogue.English: If I lose.

dialogue.content: もちろんです！
dialogue.English: Of course!

dialogue.content: でも、きっと倒せると思う
dialogue.English: But I believe you'll be able to defeat them.

dialogue.content: かかとおとしなかまだよ。
dialogue.English: The heel drop is my friend.

dialogue.content: 笑😆
dialogue.English: (laughs) 😆

dialogue.content: そうだね。。。。
dialogue.English: Right....

dialogue.content: 倒す！
dialogue.English: I'll defeat them!

dialogue.content: 悩み聞いてくれてありがと
dialogue.English: Thank you for listening to my worries.

dialogue.content: うん。お父さんの力をかりて、頑張って
dialogue.English: Yes. Borrow your dad's strength and do your best.

dialogue.content: がんばるね。
dialogue.English: I will.

dialogue.content: 応援しててね。
dialogue.English: Cheer for me, okay?

dialogue.content: うん。応援しているよ。今日は、相談に来てくれてありがとう
dialogue.English: I will. I'm cheering for you. Thank you for coming to talk today.

dialogue.content: うん。ありがと
dialogue.English: Yeah. Thanks.

dialogue.content: いじめる側は弱い人の場合もあるから、あなたが本当の強さで倒せると信じてる
dialogue.English: Sometimes the people who bully are actually weak, so I believe you can defeat them with true strength.

dialogue.content: うん。ぶっ飛ばす！
dialogue.English: Yeah. I'll send them flying!

dialogue.content: うん！
dialogue.English: Yeah!

dialogue.content: うん！
dialogue.English: Yeah!

dialogue.content: 声は聞こえないかも知れないけど、大きな声で応援してるよ。諦めずに頑張ってね
dialogue.English: You might not be able to hear my voice, but I'm cheering loudly for you. Don't give up and keep doing your best.

dialogue.content: もし１回でダメでも、必ず倒せると思う。そして、いつでも相談に来てくれたら嬉しいな
dialogue.English: Even if you don't succeed on the first try, I'm sure you can defeat them eventually. And I'd be happy if you came back to talk anytime.

dialogue.content: 今日は来てくれて本当にありがとう。そろそろお時間なので、終わりになるけど良いかな？
dialogue.English: Thank you so much for coming today. It's almost time, so is it okay if we wrap up?

dialogue.content: うん。いいよ。
dialogue.English: Yeah, that's fine.

dialogue.content: またね
dialogue.English: See you.

dialogue.content: うん。また、お待ちしているね。
dialogue.English: Yes. I'll be looking forward to seeing you again.
